content:
Dear colleagues,

We hope this message finds you well.

We are excited to announce the third virtual event “[Learning Mathematics with Lean]”, aimed at lecturers, educators, and researchers interested in incorporating Lean, an Interactive Theorem Prover, into their teaching practices.

This event will take place on April 1st, 2nd, and 3rd, 2025, between 14:00-17:00 (GMT) or 15:00-18:00 (British Summer Time - for the UK based colleagues). It will feature:

  • Presentations by lecturers using Lean to teach mathematics,
  • Undergraduate students sharing their experiences using Lean,
  • Mathematics education researchers exploring student engagement with Lean, 
  • Workshop focused on use of Lean for teaching mathematics, and
  • Discussions

If you wish to join us either on one day or for the whole event, please register using this link [Link to registration]

Please feel free to share this information with any colleagues who may find it relevant or of interest. You can also find the full schedule in the attached document (further information on the talks can be found on the website of the event “Learning Mathematics with Lean”).

We hope to see you there!

Best regards,

Athina Thoma (a.thoma@soton.ac.uk) and Paola Iannone (paola.iannone@ed.ac.uk)
